title: Back to Basics Products Recalls Iced Tea Makers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The iced tea maker's components can fail, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,000.

summary: Wires behind the control panel can overheat, posing fire and electric shock hazards. Units: About 32,000.

title: Hayes Company Inc. Recalls Outdoor Candles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The candle's wax can catch fire causing a high flame, which poses a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 83,000.

summary: These youth ATVs lack front brakes and a tire pressure gauge, the date of manufacture is not printed on side of the tires, and the front suspension is solid and does not allow for travel. title: Bunk Beds Recalled by d-Scan Due to Collapse Hazard
summary: The recalled bunk beds do not comply with federal safety standards and have wooden side slat supports that can separate from the bed frame, causing the upper bunk to collapse. Units: About 500.

title: Fisher-Price Recalls Bongo Band Toys Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the toys contain excessive levels of lead, which violates the federal law prohibiting lead paint on children's toys. Units: About 8,900.

title: Fisher-Price Recalls Geo Trax Locomotive Toys Due To Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the toys contain excessive levels of lead. Units: About 90,000.

title: Mattel Recalls Various Barbie® Accessory Toys Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the toys contain excessive levels of lead, which is prohibited under federal law. Units: About 675,000.

title: NettoCollection Recalls Cribs Due to Entrapment and Strangulation Hazard
summary: The crib slats can separate from the side rails, posing an entrapment and strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 400.

title: Lan Enterprises Recalls Doll Strollers After Child's Finger Tip was Severed; Product Also Poses an Entrapment Hazard to Young Children
summary: A child's finger can become caught in the rectangular metal clip or the black plastic side hinge, and this can sever a child's fingertip. Also, the strollers pose an entrapment hazard. Units: About 21,000.

title: Risk of Impact Injury Prompts Recall of Estes-Cox Model Rockets
summary: The model rocket's side or engine retainer ring can separate and cause the rocket to fall without the nose cone separating and the parachute deploying, posing a risk of an impact injury to nearby consumers. Units: About 80,000.

title: Kolcraft Recalls Play Yards After the Death of a 10-Month-Old Child

title: Children's Spinning Wheel-Metal Necklaces Recalled By Rhode Island Novelty Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The clasp on the necklaces contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 850.

title: Children's Toy Rakes Sold Exclusively at Jo-Ann Fabric and Craft Stores Recalled Due to Violation of Lead in Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the handle of the rake can contain excessive levels of lead paint, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 16,000.

title: Guidecraft Inc. Recalls Children’s Puppet Theaters Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the puppet theater's wooden panels contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 10,000.

title: RC2 Corp. Recalls Additional Thomas & Friends™ Wooden Railway Toys Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the toys can contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 200,000 (This recall was first announced in June 2007).

title: RC2 Recalls Knights of the Sword Toys Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the toy knights contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 800.

title: Target Recalls Children's Toy Gardening Tools and Chairs Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface paint on the recalled gardening tools and chairs contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 350,000.

title: TOBY N.Y.C. Expands Children's Metal Jewelry Recall Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The recalled metal jewelry sets contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 23,500 (about 14,000 jewelry sets were recalled on August 22, 2007).

title: BCI Recalls Swing Sets Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The connection on the top beam of the swing set can break, causing the swing beam to collapse, posing a fall hazard to the user. A user or bystander also can be injured by the falling top rail. Units: About 670.

title: About 1 Million Simplicity Cribs Recalled Due To Failures Resulting in Infant Deaths
summary: The drop-side can detach from the crib, which can create a dangerous gap and lead to the entrapment and suffocation of infants. title: REI Recalls Children's Trailer Bicycles; Can Detach from Adult Bicycle and Injure Children
summary: The children's trailer bicycle can detach from the adult bicycle, posing a fall hazard to children. Units: About 5,200.
